comments.body: Got 2 off The named kodo in mulgore
This started dropping from level 18 mobs as soon as i hit skinning 150.
I got 2 from skinning a boar in westfall @lvl 13 with 75 skinning
Just skinned 2 from a worgen in Silverpine. I was doing Arugal's Folly, so it was either a Moonrage Glutton or a Moonrage Darksoul.
Skinned one off of a lvl 14 or 15 crocodile at skill 108

It looks like the drop rate is abysmal. I've been farming these for hours off the wyverns in Stonetalon. I only got one drop of 2x, thats it. The last hour about, I had 2/5 Boutiful harvest, but I didn't get any additional drops beyond the first two.
Got 10 of it from Wailing Caverns, was skinning raptors, crocolisks and some serpents with snakes but i dont remember what was my skinning skill, but around 150 for  sure

the drop rate needs to be fixed this is worse then hunting for artic fur back in wath
im 225 skinning

duskwood for 5 hours lvl 25 to 29 mobs got 0 of them 
wetlands for 6 hours got 1 of a lvl 28 crock 
loch modan 3 hours got 0
wailing caverns ran it 4x as the only skinner got 1

This needs to be fixed you need a ton of them for makeing even your own gear but getting 2 in 20+hours of skinning is horrible and not worth the time.
hope other poeple have better luck with this because i switched to engineering because of this

Why is this considered "[b]dropped by[/b]" rather than "[b]skinned from[/b]"?

Something also seem to be wrong with the drop rate. The past few days I have been farming mobs for several hours, in several spots AND dungeons and haven't gotten one.

I then decided to unlearn skinning and level it from scratch to see if the skinning level was the issue and I've now leveled from 1-200 without a single pristine leather drop.
Y'all need to keep in mind these items are 5g from the vendor in Riverglade near the BMAH. 5g each. That is what they will be worth come live because of their rarity.

This skinning rate is tough, at  225 skinning I farmed about 600 Pridemwings in Stonetalon are Mirkfallen Lake and got 1 (off the rare spawn). Then randomly got one from skinning a level 22 ashenvale bear; roughly 1 in 601 or 0.164%

This appears to be bugged as I was getting 5-8 a day just questing until i hit level 25. After 25 I have not seen this drop from any skinned mobs, grey mobs or otherwise at all. 

There is no way this is the meant functionality but I've never seen any drop after level 25 and everyone I asks has been saying the same.
